title: My grandmother's 70th birthday
situation: Last weekend your family had a big party for your grandmother's 70th birthday. Your English friend, Sam, has asked you in an e-mail what you did at the weekend. Write an e-mail to Sam about the party.
situationHu: A családod a hétvégén a nagymamád 70. születésnapját ünnepelte; írj erről e-mailt angol barátodnak, Samnek.

points.text: say where the party was and who came
describe what you did or ate at the party
say what present you gave your grandmother and how she liked it

usefulPhrases.en: We had a party for my gran's 70th birthday.
The whole family was there, even my cousins from …
usefulPhrases.hu: Az egész család ott volt, még az unokatestvéreim is …-ból/-ből.

usefulPhrases.en: We gave her … as a present.

checklistExtra: Múlt időben (past simple) meséltem el, mi történt a bulin?

modelAnswer.text:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for your e-mail. Last weekend we had a big party for my gran's 70th birthday. It was at a restaurant by the lake in Tata, and the whole family was there, even my cousins from Vienna.

We had a delicious lunch with fish soup and chicken paprikash, and later my uncle played the guitar while we all sang.

My sister and I gave her a photo album with old family pictures. She was really surprised, and she cried a little because she loved it so much.

Write back soon!
Love,
Kata

We had a delicious lunch with fish soup and chicken paprikash, and later my uncle played the guitar while we all sang.
My sister and I gave her a photo album with old family pictures. She was really surprised, and she cried a little because she loved it so much.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a helyszín és a vendégek, az ételek és a program, majd az ajándék és a nagymama reakciója – minden szempontnál van konkrét részlet.
Szókincs: a családi ünnephez illő szavak (gran's 70th birthday, the whole family, delicious, photo album) természetesek, és a magyar ételnevek angolul is érthetők.
Nyelvhelyesség: a történetet végig múlt egyszerű idő meséli el (had, played, gave, cried), szabályos és rendhagyó igékkel is hibátlanul.
Hangnem és felépítés: baráti megszólítás, reagálás Sam levelére, három rövid bekezdés és „Write back soon!” – ez illik egy baráti e-mailhez.
Érdemes megtanulni: „the whole family was there, even …”, „while we all sang”, „She was really surprised”.
